title: Canadian smoke over the Northeast
subtitle: June 7, 2023
description: Smoke from Quebec wildfires settled over New York City, Philadelphia and Washington, D.C., producing some of the worst air quality ever recorded in the Northeast.

title: Canadian smoke over the Upper Midwest
subtitle: June 28, 2023
description: A second wave of Canadian smoke pushed into Minnesota, Wisconsin, Illinois and Michigan; Chicago briefly reported the worst air quality of any major world city.

title: West Coast Labor Day fires
subtitle: September 12, 2020
description: Wind-driven fires in Oregon, California and Washington blanketed the West Coast in dense smoke; Portland, Seattle and San Francisco recorded hazardous PM2.5.
